metadata.recipe: Replay witness from createGame(seed). To reproduce its growth route, clone witness and splice each ordinaryOpportunity.additions command at [tide-1], index, in listed order.
metadata.policyLimit: The production generator constructs an early-home/garden/late-anchor witness. Acceptance and this greedy insertion audit do not characterize the whole strategy space.

options.scope: Executable First Light comparisons using existing commands; no runtime changes or claims of player preference.

whale.tradeoff: Saves one food for the same immediate relocation and action cost, but uses the only whale favour on tide 2. Direction is fixed; the normal tow leaves that favour available. Normal drift still resolves.

support.tradeoff: Moving the garden twice costs two actions/two food instead of a one-action/one-food final bell tow. It keeps the bell offshore, with the garden providing the Heart link and windbreak while retaining its building; no extra reward or superiority is claimed.
